svg.text: AC practical safety and measurement boundaries
Variac controls voltage;it is NOT an isolation transformer.
Earth-referenced CROground clips are connected together and to protective earth.
Never defeat PE,short phases,place an ammeter across supply,or rewire energised.
Capacitors:disconnect,approved discharge,verify safe voltage;no screwdriver short.
Power-lab work only with qualified supervision;these are not DIYmains instructions.
Original conceptual teaching figure;not measured results or a live wiring authorisation.
